title: Wasserstein Least Squares: A Canonical Regression Method for Probability Distributions
summary: We perform a mathematical and statistical analysis of the Wasserstein least squares problem, a regression method for vector-valued covariates and distribution-valued responses. Our proposal contrasts with other distributional regression methods by having a direct interpretation in terms of random variables, as a nonparametric analogue of the classic random-effects model.
